Job Summary

Job Title: Senior AI Engineer - AI Engineering

Location: Pune / Bangalore

Female Candidate Preference

Join us as an AI Engineer within the AI Engineering division of DAAS (Data, AI Automation Services), specializing in Azure, AWS, and OpenShift/Azure ML DevOps. In this role, you'll:

Collaborate with different teams to propose AI solutions on different use cases across the insurance value chain, with a focus on AIops and MLOps
Research, build, and deploy AI models as part of the broader AI team, leveraging AIops and MLOps practices for efficient model management
Contribute to our DevOps practices using OpenShift or Azure ML DevOps

If you're an intermediate enthusiast in the field of AI and passionate about exploring AI use cases in insurance, seize this opportunity to join us and make a significant impact.

Technical skills
Implementation of at least 5 AI projects, preferably with experience in AIOps and MLOps
Experience with Azure, OpenShift, MLFlow DevOps for model deployment, monitoring, and management
Setting up CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI tech - LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering
Broad understanding of machine learning algorithms and techniques, including LLMs/SLMs, CNNs, RNNs, transformers, and attention mechanisms
Soft skills
Work collaboratively with broader Data and Tech teams, along with global multi-lingual teams.
Communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders for collecting requirements, communicating deliverables, value generated, challenges.
Background and experience
6-9 years of progressive experience in AI and ML, with a focus on AIops and MLOps
Experience in deploying and managing AI models in production environments using Azure ML DevOps or OpenShift
